name: Engelke Farm
tagline: Engelke Farm: Family Fun in Troy, New York
description: In Troy, NY, Engelke Farm raises Strawberries, Blackberries, Pumpkins, Corn, and Tomatoes on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
